visual_elements.description: LEFT PANEL: vertical Transformer architecture (classic 'Attention Is All You Need' figure) on a white rectangle. Bottom-left: label 'Inputs' with arrow up into pink box 'Input Embedding'; a white circle containing a black sine-wave icon labeled 'Positional Encoding' feeds a circle-plus (⊕) junction on the arrow rising into the encoder. Encoder = black rounded container labeled 'Nx' on its left side, containing bottom-to-top: orange box 'Multi-Head Attention' → yellow box 'Add & Norm' → blue box 'Feed Forward' → yellow box 'Add & Norm'; curved residual skip arrows on the left bypass each sublayer into its 'Add & Norm'. Bottom-right: label 'Outputs (shifted right)' with arrow up into pink box 'Output Embedding'; a second 'Positional Encoding' sine icon feeds a ⊕ junction into the decoder. Decoder = black rounded container labeled 'Nx' on its right side, containing bottom-to-top: orange 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' → yellow 'Add & Norm' → orange 'Multi-Head Attention' → yellow 'Add & Norm' → blue 'Feed Forward' → yellow 'Add & Norm', each with curved residual skip arrows on the right; an arrow from the encoder's top 'Add & Norm' feeds the decoder's 'Multi-Head Attention' (cross-connection). Above the decoder: lavender box 'Linear' → green box 'Softmax' → arrow up to label 'Output Probabilities'. All connectors are thin black lines with solid arrowheads.

RIGHT PANEL: identical Transformer architecture rotated 90 degrees clockwise so data flows left-to-right, on a white rectangle. Upper-left: label 'Inputs' with arrow right into pink box 'Input Embedding' (box text rotated vertical); vertical label 'Positional Encoding' with sine-wave icon feeds a ⊕ junction. Encoder strip (top) = black rounded container labeled 'Nx' above it, left-to-right: orange 'Multi-Head Attention' → yellow 'Add & Norm' → blue 'Feed Forward' → yellow 'Add & Norm', with curved residual skips below. Lower-left: vertical label 'Outputs (shifted right)' with arrow right into pink box 'Output Embedding' (vertical text); vertical 'Positional Encoding' with sine icon feeds a ⊕ junction. Decoder strip (bottom) = black rounded container labeled 'Nx' below it, left-to-right: orange 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' → yellow 'Add & Norm' → orange 'Multi-Head Attention' → yellow 'Add & Norm' → blue 'Feed Forward' → yellow 'Add & Norm' → lavender 'Linear' → green 'Softmax' → vertical label 'Output Probabilities' at far right; residual skips above; encoder output feeds the decoder's 'Multi-Head Attention'. All box texts are rotated 90 degrees (reading bottom-to-top); connectors black with arrowheads.

Thick dark-red curved arrow (open circular arc of roughly 270 degrees with a solid triangular arrowhead) placed in the gutter between the two panels at mid-height, visually indicating a 90-degree rotation from the vertical diagram to the horizontal diagram.
Slide-number badge: yellow filled circle with dark maroon outline containing the number '14' in bold dark-red text, at the top-right corner inside the frame.
Decorative frame: thin dark-maroon rectangle border inset ~2-3% from all slide edges, no fill, enclosing the entire content on the gray background.

imagery: Positional-Encoding icons: small white circles containing a black sinusoidal wave symbol, one at each input (two per diagram, four total), each connected via a small circle-plus (⊕) junction symbol into the embedding arrow.
No photographs or illustrations; all graphics are vector-style line art (boxes, arrows, rounded containers, sine icons).

Slide number '14': bold ~14pt dark red inside yellow circle. No italics, no bullet lists, no numbered lists on this slide.
